comment: Today's major river courses (rivers Task 11b): Natural Earth rivers of scalerank <= 7, and lake centrelines of those ranks that today's lake map does not cover (reservoirs; canals left out), then the cited hand-added delta channels of data/hydrology/rivers_extra.json, one entry per line part, upstream first (the end with the higher lowest ETOPO 60-second cell within 2 arc-minutes goes first), simplified to 1 km, points [lat, lon] rounded to 0.001 degrees. Where the terrain is today's, the continental pass burns each course into its routing: the running minimum of the era's node elevations along it, less TODAY_RIVER_BURN_M. Written by `timefly-bake rivers-today` (tools/bake/timefly_bake/rivers_today.py); read by timefly_core::hydrology::today_rivers.
source: Natural Earth 1:10m physical vectors, Rivers + lake centerlines, version 5.1.2 (ne_10m_rivers_lake_centerlines.geojson from github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector, tag v5.1.2; public domain, naturalearthdata.com). Oriented by ETOPO 2022 60 arc-second surface, NOAA NCEI, doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74.
